# go-cron Project Memory

## Current State (2026-03-08)
- **Latest release**: [v0.13.1](https://github.com/netresearch/go-cron/releases/tag/v0.13.1)
- **Coverage**: ~97%+
- **Fork**: netresearch/go-cron ← robfig/cron (230+ commits ahead, 0 behind)
- **Branch**: only `main` remains, all feature branches cleaned up
- **Docs**: README + API_REFERENCE fully updated for v0.11.0 ([PR #321](https://github.com/netresearch/go-cron/pull/321))

## v0.13.1 (2026-03-08)
- **Fix**: Race condition in Entry/EntryByName and ScheduleJob ([PR #336](https://github.com/netresearch/go-cron/pull/336))
- Entry/EntryByName/Entries return struct copies with cloned Tags slices

## v0.11.0 Features (2026-02-12)
- **`UpdateEntry`/`UpdateEntryByName`** (#314) - atomic schedule+job replacement
- **Per-entry context** (#315) - each entry gets own context, canceled on Remove/replacement
- **`UpdateEntryJob`/`UpdateEntryJobByName`** (#315) - parse spec + replace in one call
- **Context-propagating chain wrappers** (#316) - concurrency wrappers implement JobWithContext
- **`UpsertJob`** (#316) - atomic create-or-update named entries
- **`WaitForJob`/`WaitForJobByName`** (#318) - block until running invocations complete
- **`IsJobRunning`/`IsJobRunningByName`** (#319) - non-blocking per-entry running status

## v0.10.0 Features (2026-02-08)
1. `WithCapacity(n)` - pre-allocate internals (#287)
2. `WithMissedPolicy()` - catch-up for missed jobs (#303)
3. `RetryOnError()` - error-based retry middleware (#306)
4. `UpdateSchedule()`/`UpdateJob()` - atomic runtime updates (#307/#309)
5. `ValidateSpecWith()`/`Cron.ValidateSpec()` - rich validation (#308)

## Dependents Analysis (2026-02-08, updated 2026-02-12)

### Key Dependents
- **weaviate/weaviate** (15.5k stars) - [CybotTM/weaviate PR #1](https://github.com/CybotTM/weaviate/pull/1) using v0.11.0 (squashed, single commit)
- **Seagate/cloudfuse** (39 stars) - goroutine leak bug, needs Stop() fix
- **cloudfoundry-community/ocf-scheduler** - needs error checking, graceful shutdown
- **oszuidwest/zwfm-aerontoolbox** - textbook clean usage, minor improvements
- **netresearch/ofelia** (our own) - v0.8.0 (outdated!), richest feature source

### Upstream Done
- Reschedule → UpdateSchedule/UpdateJob (weaviate demand)
- Error-based retry → RetryOnError (ofelia pattern)
- ValidateSpec → ValidateSpecWith (ocf-scheduler + cloudfuse pattern)
- UpsertJob → atomic create-or-update named entries (weaviate demand)
- WaitForJob → graceful job replacement (weaviate demand)
- Per-entry context → auto-canceled on replacement (weaviate demand)
- Context-propagating chain wrappers → concurrency wrappers pass ctx through
- IsJobRunning → non-blocking per-entry status query (monitoring)
- CircuitBreaker state monitoring → CircuitBreakerWithHandle + WithStateChangeCallback (#185)
- RetryWithBackoff attempt callback → WithRetryCallback + RetryAttempt (#186)

## Technical Notes
- **Context propagation**: Concurrency wrappers (Recover, SkipIfStillRunning, DelayIfStillRunning, Timeout, TimeoutWithContext, Jitter, JitterWithLogger) implement JobWithContext. Resilience wrappers (RetryWithBackoff, RetryOnError, CircuitBreaker) return FuncJob and do NOT forward context.
- **jobTracker pattern**: Custom mutex+counter+channel type replaces sync.WaitGroup for per-entry tracking. WaitGroup has documented race when Add(positive) called concurrent with Wait() at counter=0. jobTracker: start()/finish()/wait()/isRunning() all mutex-protected.
- **sync.Once in tests**: When using `@every` + `WithRunImmediately()`, guard channel closes with `sync.Once` to prevent panics on repeated executions. `WithRunOnce()` removes entry before job finishes, making WaitForJob return immediately - don't use it for WaitForJob tests.
- **Protected main branch**: Can't push directly to main — must use PRs. For releases: create release branch, PR, merge, then `git tag -s` locally and push tag, then `gh release create`.
- **WithContext semantics**: `cron.New(WithContext(ctx))` derives a child context via `context.WithCancel(ctx)`. `Stop()` cancels the derived child, not the caller's ctx.
- **CI annotations lesson**: CI checks can PASS while emitting warning annotations (actionlint/reviewdog, CodeQL deprecation). Always check job annotations before declaring a PR clean. Configure reviewdog actions with `fail_level: error` (not deprecated `fail_on_error` + `level`).
- **Go versions in CI**: Matrix tests Go 1.25.x + 1.26.x. Coverage artifacts include Go version in name to avoid collisions.
- **Auto-approve race condition**: The PR Quality Gates auto-approve job can race with Copilot reviewer. If auto-approve runs while Copilot is still reviewing, it sees Copilot as pending and skips approval. Stale review dismissal then clears previous approvals on new pushes. Fix: re-run the workflow via `gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/actions/runs/RUN_ID/rerun -X POST` after Copilot finishes.
